consumedSemantics: a final prior-evening session is consumed only by next-day My Day; previously consumed sources must not be rebound silently
eveningAdjustment: Final evening D-1 contributes to My Day D, never My Day D-1
idempotency: orchestration identity excludes consumed/fresh role and session revision so generation-success/consume-failure retry converges
forbidden: raw answers in My Day command
direct checkin DB reads from My Day
updating provenance of a stored My Day
late morning sources for an existing My Day
targetDateRule: My Day D uses MORNING on D and EVENING on D-1 in the user's canonical timezone

oneGenerationPerDay.rule: one successful generation per (user, local date); a stored My Day(D) is returned as it is and nothing later changes its sources or consumes a session for it
oneGenerationPerDay.sourcesFixedAtGeneration: Morning(D) takes part only if final before the plan; a morning left mutable after its window closed is auto-finalised before sources are read
oneGenerationPerDay.morningAfterPlan: closed until the evening: allowedEntryAction NONE, entryBlockedReason MY_DAY_PLAN_ALREADY_SET, start and submit 409 CHECKIN_MORNING_PLAN_ALREADY_SET
oneGenerationPerDay.planKind: PERSONAL when Morning(D) or Evening(D-1) contributes (effectiveShare > 0); STANDARD only when neither does; derived from provenance, never from the request source
oneGenerationPerDay.screenASecondary: GENERAL when Evening(D-1) does not contribute, FROM_EVENING_CHECKIN when it does; it always matches the kind of the plan generate(source STANDARD) produces
oneGenerationPerDay.autoGeneration: GET /api/v1/my-day/today after the morning window closes with no plan generates once; a failure returns NOT_GENERATED with generationFailure and planChoice
